notes.title: We Have a New Release Date! And a little demo update!
notes.notes:
Hello!

We had initially planned to release on the 21st but have had to push the release date (by just one short week) to the 28th April 2025! Apologies for the delay. 

We also pushed a small patch to our demo a couple of days ago. It included some bug fixes, a new main menu and some new interactables we've been working on (P.S. you can now ring the bell at Flib's house and do some other silly things around the island)

Thank you to everyone who played our demo, wishlisted or shared our game. It makes such a difference and we really appreciate you. 

If you are a content creator and would like to cover Flibbius you are welcome to reach out to me on BlueSky ( @niminy.bsky.social ) and request a key or by emailing me: romy@unsigneddouble.com 

We are SO excited to share our game with you 🥳 Have a wonderful day!

notes.title: Demo Patch: 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[b]Demo Patch Notes:[/b]

[*] Fixed game breaking bug where you could accidentally not get needle and thread if you exited a dialog before it was completed.
[*] Adjusted dialog to make some hints more subtle.

[*] Added sprint UI Icon

[*] Adjusted UI to work better on steamdeck
